meta.name: growing-outside-in-systems
meta.description: Drive feature development using Outside-In TDD with Hexagonal Architecture. Design emerges through inline code, in-memory fakes, interface extraction, and deferred I/O. Use when building features, writing tests, or structuring backend services. Triggers on: TDD, outside-in, hexagonal, ports and adapters, emergent design, acceptance test, component test, walking skeleton, in-memory fakes, component, contract test, adapter, fast tests, sub-second feedback. Language-agnostic (Go, Rust, Python, TypeScript, Java, C#).

howto.what: 使用外部驱动TDD和六边形架构开发功能：从编写验收测试开始，经过内联代码、内存假对象、接口提取，最后延迟实现真实I/O。
howto.when: 当你要构建功能、编写测试或设计后端服务，以及提到“TDD”、“六边形架构”、“端口和适配器”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个验收测试，测试用户注册功能。
按照内联→内存假对象→接口的顺序实现这个适配器。
检查这段代码是否符合六边形架构的依赖方向。

howto.what_en: Drives feature development using Outside-In TDD with Hexagonal Architecture: starts with an acceptance test, then inline code, in-memory fakes, interface extraction, and deferred I/O.
howto.when_en: Triggers when building features, writing tests, or structuring backend services, and when mentioning TDD, outside-in, hexagonal architecture, ports and adapters, etc.

say_en.text: Write an acceptance test for user registration.
Implement this adapter following inline -> in-memory fake -> interface.
Check if this code respects hexagonal dependency rule.
